---
title: Meeting of South West RSEs at the University of Bath
---

**When**: Friday 31st July 2026, 10am – 4:00pm (refreshments from 9:30am for a 10am start)

**Where**: 10 West 2.47, University of Bath, Claverton Down, Bath, BA2 7AY (A3 on [campus map](https://www.bath.ac.uk/publications/claverton-down-campus-map/attachments/university-campus-map.pdf))

## Purpose

It will be another day to showcase interesting topics, share knowledge and build networks.
All are welcome, whether or not you are from the South West of the UK, and whether or not you self-define as a Research Software Engineer (RSE).
[What is an RSE?](https://society-rse.org/what-is-an-rse/)

## Registration

[Register to attend](https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=Ij1-N6FOLUKwrY_MiUBrnqJBc3HLK_dOiPrjjBCsFMlUNDdSRUlVTUMxVEgzVVhEUTNSS1c3Q0M5Ri4u){.btn .btn-primary}

**Deadline for registering for talks passed (Friday 10th July 2026)**
**Registration closed: Monday 20th July 2026**.
It is too late to arrange additional lunches, but interested parties can still sign up to attend the talks.

## Outline Agenda

### 9:30-10:00 Welcome refreshments

Collect name badges and morning refreshments on level 2 of 10 West.

### 10:00-10:10 Introduction

- Introduction from Bath's RSE Facility.
- James Thomas (Bristol): Introduction to RSE South West mailing list and website.

### 10:10-10:55 Keynote speaker

- Ed Bennett (Swansea): TBC

### 10:55-11:15 Morning refreshments

### 11:15-12:15 Contributed talks 1

Lightning talks:

- Tom Burnett (Bath) Intro to the Institute for Mathematical Innovation
- Miquel Perellonieto (UoB) Launching our Mathematics Innovation Initiative​
- Wilf Wilson (MO) SSE in space weather at the Met Office
- TBC (Bath) work experience experience

Talks:

- Elizabeth Mamchits (STFC/DAFNI) Five Lessons from Developing and Supporting the DAFNI Research Platform
- Lewis Sampson (STFC/DAFNI) Through the lens of the DAFNI, maintaining a digital research infrastructure platform with industry standard tooling

### 12:15-13:00 Lunch

Taking packed lunches either on the balcony or by the lake (5 minute walk).

### 13:00-14:00 Contributed talks 2

Lightning talks:

- Mateus Bernado-Harrigton (Cardiff) Pair Programming as Peer Mentorship: Building Research Software Communities One Session at a Time
- Evie James (UoB) Plotting the route from research engineering to policy: a Quarto geospatial analytics toolkit built with and for local government
- Emma Hogan (MO) What Happened Next? Advancing learning resources for iterative, customer-focused development of research software

Talks:

- Elvira Alier Retamar (Bath) Current hot topics coming to DDaT
- Josh Tyler (UoB) Have I Learnt Python?

### 14:00-14:20 Afternoon refreshments

### 14:20-15:25 Contributed talks 3 and discussion

Lightning Talks:

- Francesco Devoto (MO) Machine Learning for Visibility Range Forecasting and Classification
- Honey Chauhan (Bath) Thousand calculations - multiple options: Choosing an HPC submission strategy
- Rita Rasteiro (UoB) DEICAP: Measuring the Hidden Carbon Cost of Digital Research

Talks:

Discussion:

### 15:25-15:30 Close

### Social

An informal pub trip to the beer garden at [The Bell Inn](https://thebellinnbath.co.uk/beer-garden/), which serves sourdough pizza from [The Pizza Bike](https://thebellinnbath.co.uk/pizza/).

The Bell Inn, 103 Walcot Street, Bath BA1 5BW
